rebrandingModel.summary: Rebranding surface is 14 editable WordPress/Divi pages + 2 Ecwid templates + 1 global theme layer. It is NOT 501 individual pages.

surfaces.editable: via Ecwid design settings + custom CSS only
surfaces.how: Ecwid Control Panel > Design, plus CSS overrides injected from WordPress

ecwid-templates — covers 501 store routes with 2 edits
about-sadko + stores-location — brand storytelling and trust

track-your-order — currently a 'Coming Soon' placeholder; rebuild or remove

designTokens.source: Extracted from compiled Divi CSS and inline critical CSS
designTokens.colorNotes: #2ea3f2 is an UNCHANGED Divi factory default, not a deliberate brand choice — it leaks through links and buttons. #7ebec5 teal is the actual brand accent. A rebrand should eliminate #2ea3f2 entirely.

logo.note: Only a white version is in use — there is no dark-background-safe or monochrome variant. A rebrand needs a full logo lockup set.

nav.note: page is a placeholder; real tracking is external at movex.com.eg
